title: Submillimetre hot-electron transport in manganese-doped quantum dot solids
description:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11279-9

A phototransport regime driven by spin exchange is demonstrated in manganese-doped quantum dot solids, enabling the generation, long-range transport and regeneration of hot carriers and yielding submillimetre drift lengths.
